title: Spanish Festival Night
coreRelationships: The fireworks burst above the town, contrasting with the dark night sky.
The architectural elements (buildings, bridge) create depth and structure within the composition.
The running bulls in the foreground establish a sense of movement and cultural context.
The vibrant red and yellow buildings provide strong color anchors against the darker background.
The text 'SPAIN' firmly grounds the image's identity at the bottom.
reuseFormula: Recreate a stylized travel poster for a specific location by combining iconic architectural elements, cultural symbols, and a celebratory event (like fireworks) within a flat, high-contrast color palette. Include the location name in a decorative font at the bottom.
